title: Ultstar Art Showcase: OÃ¡sis Dourado
author: Ms. Desire
content:
Unleash your creativity in the **Ultstar Art Showcase**! Submit your best Ult & Co.-themed artwork celebrating our game characters, environments, or futuristic tech. This year's theme: **OÃ¡sis Dourado**, highlighting its beauty and mystery.

_This year, we're particularly interested in works that incorporate {metallic:liquid metal} textures and subtle {glow:#ADD8E6|aurora effects} in the background, especially as applied to character armor or futuristic structures. Imagine a shimmering desert oasis city bathed in the glow of a binary star system!_ A high-quality submission can truly capture the spirit. Also, consider adding a small ![Game Icon](https://placehold.co/30x30/000/fff?text=ðŸŽ®) in a discrete corner.

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: {color:#FFD700|Wacom Cintiq Pro 24} + your art featured as loading screen art in our next major game title.
- 2nd Place: $200 Game Dev Store gift card.
- 3rd Place: $100 Game Dev Store gift card.

**Rules & Guidelines:**
- [x] Must be original artwork. ~No AI-generated content~ to ensure fairness and artistic integrity. 
- [ ] Use Ult & Co. game IP, characters, or lore themes only. Avoid ^external^ IPs that are not licensed.
- [ ] Submission format: high-res .PNG or .JPG (min. 300dpi). Submissions must include a 16:9 aspect ratio version for potential in-game use.
- [ ] Deadline: August 31, 2025. Submissions *after* 23:59:59 PM UTC will be ^disqualified^.

---

Check out some ~inspiration~ from last year's winners, showcasing their incredible talent! 

**Key Elements to Consider:**
* **Color Palette**: Embrace warm golds and cool blues. Focus on contrast and vibrancy to make your art pop on screen.
* **Composition**: Focus on strong focal points and dynamic layouts. Consider the rule of thirds for cinematic appeal.
* **Narrative**: Tell a story with your art, however subtle. Perhaps a character's journey through a forgotten level or a moment of _epic triumph_.
* **Detail**: Pay attention to the small things that bring a piece to life, even down to the smallest ~pixel artifact~.

Here's a quick look at how the prizes stack up:

| Rank | Reward Type | Value |
|:----|:-----------|:------|
| 1   | Hardware    | Drawing Tablet |
| 2   | Gift Card   | $200 |
| 3   | Gift Card   | $100 |

See the [developer portal](https://ultandco.com/dev/art-contests) for full details. Watch our {sparkle:game trailer} for more visual inspiration: @[youtube](dQw4w9WgXcQ).

title: Starlight Animation Jam: Surprising Discovery
author: Addie
content:
Bring our characters to life! Create a short animation (5-15 seconds) based on the theme: **'A Surprising Discovery'**.

This theme encourages unique interpretations, whether it's a character discovering a new game mechanic, uncovering a lost lore artifact, or encountering something entirely unexpected within a game world. We value both **narrative clarity** and _technical execution_ of animation principles.

Here's a fantastic example from our lead animator, showcasing a character's reaction to a new item:
@[youtube](dQw4w9WgXcQ)

**Prizes:**
- Grand Prize: A one-on-one virtual mentorship session with a lead animator at Ult & Co.! This is a {sparkle:once-in-a-lifetime opportunity} to learn from industry veterans.
- Runner-Up: A professional animation software license (e.g., Autodesk Maya subscription).
- Honorable Mentions: Ult & Co. game development swag pack.

**Rules:**
- [x] Animation must be your own work. ~~Plagiarism or reuse of non-licensed assets will result in immediate disqualification.~~
- [ ] Must feature at least one official Ult & Co. game character. You can find character model and rig packs in the [assets section](https://ultandco.com/assets).
- [ ] Submit a link to your animation on UltTube (our platform's video sharing service). Ensure it's _public_ or ^unlisted^ for judging.

Good luck, creators! We're excited to see what game animation discoveries you bring to life!

title: Project Chimera: Game Modding Competition
author: The Engineer
content:
Forge the future of gaming! We're challenging the community to build the most innovative game mod using our new Chimera Engine. This is your chance to show off your **game design prowess** and _technical scripting flair_.

![Chimera Mod Concept](https://placehold.co/600x300/1a1a3a/3b82f6?text=Game+Mod+Concept)

**Theme:** Cybernetic Integration. We're looking for seamless blending of new gameplay systems into existing game mechanics, or innovative UI/UX designs. Consider adding new enemy AI that learns from player behavior, or a dynamic quest system. Even a subtle {glow:#FF00FF|holographic UI overlay} effect can make a difference!

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: A one-of-a-kind Ult & Co. prototype {color:#3b82f6|Quantum CPU} for accelerated game compilation! This is a top-tier reward for serious developers.
- 2nd Place: $500 game engine asset store voucher.
- 3rd Place: A full set of Ult & Co. developer tools and software licenses.

**Rules:**
- [x] Mod must be fully playable within the Chimera Engine. ~~Concept art or design documents alone are not sufficient.~~
- [ ] Submissions require a gameplay video showcase and a detailed design document outlining changes and new features. Video should be ^high-quality^ and demonstrate all new features.
- [ ] Adhere to all engine usage guidelines. Improper use of _engine features_ or crashing bugs will lead to disqualification.

Good luck, game modders! We look forward to seeing your incredible creations!

title: Lab Notes: Game Lore Writing - Lost Dev Diary
author: The Archivist
content:
Flesh out the world of Ult & Co. games! Write a short story (500-2000 words) from the perspective of a game developer, an NPC, or even a sentient AI within the game's code.

**Prompt:** An entry from a lost game development diary. Your entry should detail a _curious bug_ or a **design anomaly** encountered during the creation of an Ult & Co. game. Make it engaging and thought-provoking, perhaps with a touch of debugging frustration or unexpected discovery. Perhaps even a subtle {sparkle:glitch in the Matrix} could be hinted at, changing gameplay forever!

**Checklist:**
- [x] Story is between 500-2000 words. 
- [ ] Word count checker online: [link](https://www.wordcounter.net). Make sure your story meets the _minimum_ word count for full consideration.
- [x] Includes a clear observation of a game bug or design anomaly. It should be the central focus of the diary entry.
- [ ] Character voice (developer, NPC, AI) is distinct and consistent throughout. Consider their role in the game world.
- [ ] Submitted by deadline. Check out some tips for ^better game writing^.

**Prizes:**
- Your story canonized on the official Ult & Co. Game Lore Hub. This means it becomes _official_ game lore, acknowledged in future titles!
- A rare Ult & Co. branded gaming keyboard with custom keycaps. Perfect for future *game designers*.

**Rules:**
- Submissions must be in plain text format. No embedded images or complex formatting. Focus on the prose.
- Adhere to established game lore (or justify your creative liberties!). Any major deviations should be explained in a footnote ~or appendix~.
- Deadline: July 25, 2025. Late submissions will be ~automatically rejected~ from judging.

**Example Dev Diary Structure:**

| Section      | Description                               |
|:-------------|:------------------------------------------|
| Date/Time    | When the entry was written.               |
| Build/Version| The game build or version being discussed.|
| Observation  | Details of the bug/anomaly.               |
| Debug Notes  | Your character's thoughts/hypotheses.     |
| Dev ID       | The author's developer ID.                |

Good luck, aspiring game writers and storytellers! We eagerly await your digital discoveries. Don't let your creative ideas be ~lost in the code~!

title: Iris Lab Speedrun Trial: Test 7 - Core Override
author: Iris
content:
Iris is recruiting the fastest minds for a simulated lab trial. This is a chance to prove your **reflexes** and strategic thinking within our newest game simulation!

**Scenario:** Test 7 â€“ Core Override, Any% Completion. Navigate the simulated labyrinth and disable the core as quickly as possible. Every millisecond counts!

Top performers will be immortalized on the UltLab Leaderboard Wall! Can you beat the current **world record of ^1:23:45^**? Watch the current record run for inspiration: @[youtube](dQw4w9WgXcQ).

title: Cyber-Security Analyst Exam: Network Defender
author: The Engineer
content:
Prove your mettle as a **Network Defender**! This comprehensive Cyber-Security Analyst Exam tests your knowledge of threat detection, incident response, and network hardening techniques.

Prepare for a rigorous assessment that includes both theoretical questions and practical simulation exercises. Success in this exam signifies your readiness to protect Ult & Co.'s critical infrastructure. This certification is a {metallic:golden opportunity} for your career path!

**Exam Format:**

| Section      | Focus Area                           | Questions |
|:-------------|:-------------------------------------|:----------|
| Section 1    | _Network Fundamentals_               | 20        |
| Section 2    | **Threat Intelligence** | 15        |
| Section 3    | Incident Response                    | 10        |
| Section 4    | Vulnerability Management             | 10        |
| Section 5    | Crypto~graphy~ Basics                | 5         |
| Section 6    | ^Practical Simulation^               | 1         |

**Requirements for Passing:**
- [x] Achieve a score of 70% or higher. 
- [ ] Complete all exam sections within the allotted 3 hours. 
- [ ] Adhere to the honor code. Any detected ~cheating attempts~ will result in immediate disqualification.

**Reward:**
Passing participants will receive the official {sparkle:Certified Network Defender} digital badge and a physical certificate. Failing participants will receive a notification: {color:#FF5C5C|Failed Certification - Retake Recommended}. Learn more in our [introductory video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ).

Good luck, future defenders! Your expertise is crucial.

title: Creator Circuit Cup: Starry Night / Low Gravity
author: Addie
content:
Build the most creative challenge in the UltSim Construction Kit with this round's theme: **Starry Night / Low Gravity**.

We're looking for innovative mechanics and breathtaking visuals! Consider how you can use the low-gravity environment to create unique puzzles or movement challenges. Think beyond simple jumps; perhaps a sequence of precise {color:#8B008B|momentum-based maneuvers} is needed. Incorporate elements that truly capture the 'Starry Night' feel, like shimmering platforms or distant celestial bodies.

**Requirements:**
- Use at least 3 interactive logic blocks. These could be switches, timers, or custom contraptions to create dynamic gameplay.
- Publish and tag your map in UltCloud. Ensure the tag is `CCC25-StarLow` for proper categorization.
- Vote-based rankings; highest stars win! Community feedback is crucial for determining the winner, so aim for broad appeal.

Top course will be showcased in Addie's next internal demo stream. Get creative! This is your chance to shine and show off your _ingenuity_ in game level design. Don't be afraid to add some hidden lore elements or a secret room!

title: Styletide Fashion Gala: Neo-Retro Futurism
author: Lulu
content:
Show us your style! Design and submit your best Ult & Co. inspired game character outfit or in-game cosmetic. Submissions can be a real-world cosplay or in-game character customizations, focusing on digital aesthetics.

This year's theme is: **Neo-Retro Futurism**.

We're looking for bold designs that merge the classic aesthetics of early sci-fi games with modern, avant-garde character design elements. Think sleek lines, metallic armor accents, and perhaps a touch of {glow:#FF00FF|cyber-punk flair} in the glowing neon pipes or intricate circuitry. Don't be afraid to experiment with _unconventional_ virtual materials or **digital textures** and shader effects.

**Prizes:**
- Your design featured as an official in-game cosmetic in our next major title! This is a {sparkle:massive opportunity} to leave your mark on the game world.
- A professional 3D character model commission (for digital artists) or 10,000 Ult-Credits (for in-game items).

**Rules:**
- [x] Must be a new design created specifically for this contest. ~~No recycled or previously submitted designs.~~
- [ ] Provide high-quality renders from multiple angles. For digital submissions, include wireframes and texture maps if possible.
- [ ] Submission must clearly showcase the theme. A short paragraph explaining your design choices and how they fit the game world is ^encouraged^.

Get ready to set the *Styletide* for in-game fashion! This is your moment to redefine _futuristic character aesthetics_!

title: Dream Weavers Game Jam: Echoes
author: Lulu
content:
Let's make games! The Dream Weavers Game Jam is a 48-hour event to create a game using official Ult & Co. character assets. This is an intense, fun challenge to push your creative and technical limits.

Theme: **Echoes**. Interpret it how you wish! Maybe a character's past, recurring gameplay events, or sound-based puzzles. Think about how the concept of 'echoes' can influence your gameplay mechanics, art style, or narrative. A strong and innovative interpretation can lead to a {color:#FFFF00|winning entry}!

All entries will be featured in a special showcase on the UltSim launcher! This is a chance to show your skills. Build something amazing! Consider adding a hidden 'easter egg' related to the theme, or a secret _lore entry_.

**Rules:**
- [x] Must use at least one official Ult & Co. character asset. ~~No third-party character models or unlicensed assets.~~
- [ ] Game must be playable and submit a working build. Bugs and crashes will significantly affect your score. ^Test thoroughly^ on multiple platforms if possible.
- [ ] Adhere to the 48-hour time limit. Proof of work-in-progress (e.g., commit history, time-lapse) is required.

May your dreams be woven into incredible games!

title: Trivia of Temptation: The Game Lore Edition
author: Ms. Desire
content:
Join Ms. Desire in a battle of brains and boldness! This is your chance to prove your **knowledge of Ult & Co. game lore** and claim ultimate bragging rights within the community.

**Event:** 5 quiz rounds themed on Ult & Co. game lore, character backstories, in-game inventions, historical events, and even fan theories. Each round presents a unique challenge, from multiple-choice to fill-in-the-blank. The final round is the: **Rapid Fire Blitz**.

Top scorers get exclusive in-game emotes, unique avatars, and possibly a secret visit to the *OÃ¡sis Dourado development vaults* (if you can navigate the game's security protocols, of course!). This is a {color:#FFD700|highly coveted prize} for true lore masters!

_Are you ready to be tempted by knowledge_? This is a chance to prove your ^mastery^ of the Ult & Co. game universe. Don't miss out! Even the most obscure in-game facts might lead you to victory. Learn more in our [promotional video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ).

**Rules:**
- [x] Must answer all questions truthfully. ~~No outside help or collaboration permitted during the live quiz.~~
- [ ] Each round has a strict time limit per question. Rapid responses are _key_ to maximizing your score.
- [ ] Decisions of the quizmaster are final. Disputes will not be entertained.

Good luck, trivia enthusiasts!

title: The Wanderer's Cipher: A Hidden Truth
author: The Wanderer
content:
The signal is fragmented. A series of encrypted data files have been seeded across the __UltNet__ within our latest game update. The first one to piece them together and decrypt the **final message** will uncover a hidden truth long forgotten about the game's lore. This challenge requires keen observation and deductive reasoning. Perhaps a subtle {color:#008080|pattern recognition} within game files or environmental clues is key.

__The first clue lies where light cannot escape in-game.__ (Hint: Think *black holes* or *dark zones* in our sci-fi universe.) Follow the trail of fragmented data hidden across various Ult & Co. game servers and in-game locations.

**How to Participate:**
- Collect the scattered fragments. They are hidden in unexpected places, from obscure NPC dialogue to hidden corners of the map. You might need to explore _old game archives_ or forgotten levels.
- Use the Cipher Toolkit (provided in the game's developer console) to decrypt each piece. This toolkit has all the necessary cryptographic functions, but not the explicit instructions. You must infer the decryption method based on clues.
- Submit the final decrypted message to Iris's in-game terminal. Make sure your submission is ^accurate^; even a single incorrect character means failure and a penalty to your final time.

**Prize:**
- Your name etched into the Wanderer's monolith in-game, forever a part of the lore. This is a {metallic:permanent tribute} to your intellect, visible to all players!

**Rules:**
- [x] First valid decryption key submitted to Iris wins. This is a time-sensitive competition, logged to the millisecond. ~~Second place gets bragging rights only.~~
- [ ] Collaboration is permitted, but only one player can claim the prize. Choose your allies wisely, but remember only one can achieve true recognition.
- [ ] Do not publicly share clues or answers until after the deadline. Breach of this rule will result in {glow:#FF0000|immediate disqualification} from this and future contests, and data purge from the leaderboards. Our anti-cheat systems are very advanced.

Good luck, Seekers of Truth! The vast game universe awaits your solution. Don't let the ~mystery~ consume your playtime!

title: Ult & Co. Kart Night GP: Neon Circuit
author: Lulu
content:
Buckle up for 12 grueling laps in the most chaotic simulation race this side of the multicloud! This Grand Prix demands _precision driving_ and **strategic item usage**.

Navigate the treacherous turns and dazzling straightaways of the **Neon Circuit**, a track known for its unexpected shortcuts and dangerous hazards. Only the best drivers will survive the intense competition!

**Race Format:**

| Setting      | Value       |
|:-------------|:------------|
| Laps         | 12          |
| Engine Class | 150cc       |
| Items Enabled| Max         |

Top 3 earn golden kart icons and a year of UltPass Pro. Can you handle the pressure of the **Neon Circuit**? Master every turn, and don't forget to drift around those {color:#FFFF00|sharp corners} for maximum boost! You'll need every advantage to beat the competition. This is a game of skill and a little bit of luck!

**Rules:**
- [x] Must use an official Ult & Co. racing kart. ~~No custom vehicle mods or stat-altering cheats allowed.~~
- [ ] Fair play is mandatory; intentional collisions or griefing will result in disqualification. Players caught using ^exploits^ or glitches will be banned from all future events.
- [ ] Best single race time determines placement. No aggregate scores across multiple races.

May the fastest driver win!

title: Cosmic Code Challenge: AI Game Agent
author: The Engineer
content:
Program the smartest AI agent to navigate the 'Cosmic Labyrinth' in our new simulation game. Your agent must collect all energy particles and find the exit in the shortest time. This challenge combines **complex algorithms** with _real-time game execution_.

**Goal:** Optimal pathfinding and resource management for your AI agent within the game environment. We're looking for solutions that demonstrate both speed and efficiency, minimizing computational overhead and avoiding unnecessary actions. A truly elegant solution will achieve a perfect score and a special {sparkle:Cosmic Champion} title in-game!

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: Paid internship opportunity at Ult & Co. AI Game Development Division. This is a {metallic:career-defining} opportunity to work on our next-gen game AI.
- 2nd Place: Advanced AI Game Development Kit.
- 3rd Place: $300 gaming peripheral voucher.

**Rules:**
- [x] Code must be original and written by you. ~~Plagiarized code will result in immediate disqualification and a ban from all future contests.~~
- [ ] Submissions in Python or JavaScript. Other languages are not supported for this challenge. Only use ^standard libraries^ compatible with our game engine.
- [ ] No hard-coded paths allowed. Your AI must adapt to dynamic game environments and changing obstacles. Solutions with _fixed routes_ will fail the dynamic test cases.

May the best algorithm win! Check the [Game AI API Documentation](https://ultandco.com/api/game-ai) for details on agent interaction and environmental data.

title: Soundscape Synthesis Challenge: Game Audio
author: Lulu
content:
Create an immersive 60-second soundscape for an unrevealed Ult & Co. game environment. Focus on atmosphere, depth, and unique sonic textures that enhance gameplay. We're looking for creations that transport the listener to another in-game world, evoking a strong sense of place and emotion.

**Theme:** The Whispering Void. Interpret this as a desolate alien planet, a bustling futuristic city street, or a haunting, abandoned space station. Consider using binaural audio for a truly immersive and directional sound experience.

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: Your soundscape integrated into a future Ult & Co. game environment. Your name will be etched into the {metallic:Game Audio Credits}!
- 2nd Place: Professional Audio Workstation Software Suite (e.g., Reaper, Ableton Live).
- 3rd Place: High-fidelity studio monitoring headphones (e.g., Sennheiser HD 600).

**Rules:**
- [x] Must be original audio composition. ~~No copyrighted material unless you own the license for game use.~~
- [ ] Submission in WAV or FLAC format. Ensure your audio is _high-fidelity_ and uncompressed.
- [ ] Max length 60 seconds. Submissions exceeding this will be truncated. Avoid submitting a score of ~0.5~ or less, aim for excellence and professional quality!

Let your creativity resonate! We eagerly await the immersive sounds of your game worlds.

title: Quantum Puzzle Paradox: Entangled Minds
author: Iris
content:
Decode the fabric of game reality! A series of **quantum puzzles** have been created by Iris herself within our newest game simulation. Solve them to unlock the secrets of {metallic:Entangled Minds} within the game's code and lore! This challenge will test your intuition, logic, and ability to think beyond classical game mechanics. Expect paradoxes and mind-bending scenarios that will challenge your understanding of the game world. The truth often lies in the most unexpected game files or hidden debug menus, so observe every detail.

Here's a quick overview of the challenge stages:

| Stage        | Description                                          |
|:-------------|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| Induction    | Basic quantum game mechanics, simple logic gates.    |
| Superposition| Handling probabilistic gameplay outcomes.            |
| Entanglement | Linking distant game states or NPC behaviors.        |
| Decoherence  | Breaking the game's quantum state.                   |

**Prizes:**
- Grand Prize: A {sparkle:personalized message from Iris herself} on the nature of game reality! This is a unique opportunity to gain insight from our advanced game AI.
- 2nd Place: Advanced Game Logic & Scripting textbook signed by our lead game physicist.
- 3rd Place: $150 gift card for experimental game development hardware.

**Rules:**
- [x] All puzzles must be solved sequentially within the game. You cannot skip stages or bypass game progression. 
- [ ] Solutions must be documented clearly and concisely within an in-game journal. Explain your reasoning steps and any ^complex derivations^ you used to bypass seemingly impossible situations.
- [ ] Cheating or unauthorized modification of game files will result in {glow:#FF0000|immediate disqualification} from this and future contests, and data purge from the leaderboards. Our anti-cheat systems are designed to detect anomalous behavior, so do not attempt to bypass game mechanics. Avoid ~collusion~ with other players to solve puzzles.

Good luck, theoreticians! The game universe awaits your solution. Check out our intro video for more context on the Quantum Puzzle Paradox within the game: @[youtube](dQw4w9WgXcQ).

title: Game Asset Remix Challenge: Retro-Futurism
author: Addie
content:
Give our classic game assets a modern twist! Remix any existing Ult & Co. game asset (3D model, texture, sound, or animation) with a **Retro-Futurism** theme.

We're looking for creative reinterpretations that blend old-school charm with futuristic concepts. Imagine a pixel-art character rendered with modern shaders, or a chiptune soundtrack re-orchestrated with synthetic orchestral elements. Your work should feel both familiar and refreshingly new!

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: Your remixed asset integrated into a future Ult & Co. game update! Your name will be featured in the _developer credits_.
- 2nd Place: Professional Game Asset Creation Software License.
- 3rd Place: $150 gift card for digital asset marketplaces.

**Rules:**
- [x] Must use at least one original Ult & Co. asset as a base. ~~Submissions without an identifiable base asset will be disqualified.~~
- [ ] Submit both the original and remixed asset. Provide a short explanation of your creative process and how you achieved the ^retro-futuristic^ aesthetic.
- [ ] Max file size 500MB for all submitted assets. Keep your projects optimized!

Show us how you blend the past and future of game design!

title: Game Dev Pitch Competition: The Next Big Hit
author: Ms. Desire
content:
Do you have the next big game idea? Pitch it to Ult & Co. Publishing and secure a development deal!

We're looking for innovative concepts, compelling gameplay loops, and strong market potential. Your pitch should clearly articulate your game's unique selling points and target audience. A well-researched pitch deck with strong visuals can make all the difference.

**Prizes:**
- 1st Place: A full publishing deal with Ult & Co.! This includes funding, marketing, and development support. A {sparkle:dream come true} for any indie developer.
- 2nd Place: $5000 seed funding + mentorship from an Ult & Co. producer.
- 3rd Place: Comprehensive game development software bundle.

**Rules:**
- [x] Submit a 10-minute video pitch and a concise pitch deck. ~~Late submissions will not be considered.~~
- [ ] Game concept must be original. No adaptation of existing IPs unless licensed. Avoid using ^stock assets^ without proper attribution.
- [ ] Pitch must include a clear monetization strategy. Even free-to-play games need a plan.

Good luck, visionary developers! Show us the future of gaming!

title: Test Contest: All Rich Text Features
author: Gemini
content:
Welcome to the **Ultimate Rich Text Test Contest**! This contest showcases _all_ available formatting features for debugging purposes. Let's explore:

---

**Inline Text Styles:**

- **Bold Text**: This text should appear bold.
- _Italic Text_: This text should be italicized.
- __Underlined Text__: This text should be underlined.
- ~~Strikethrough Text~~: This text should have a line through it.
- ^Superscript^: This text is superscripted. (Like E=mc^2^)
- ~Subscript~: This text is subscripted. (Like H~2~O)
- {color:#FF00FF|Colored Text}: This text has a custom color (magenta).
- {metallic:Metallic Text}: This text should have a metallic effect.
- {sparkle:Sparkle Text}: This text should have a sparkle effect.
- {glow:#00FF00|Glow Text}: This text should have a green glow.
- Prize Text: This is a {prize:$10,000} grand prize!
- {outline:blue,2|Blue Outline}: This text has a blue outline.
- {shadow:#000000,5;5;10|Shadowed Text}: This text has a custom drop shadow.
- {gradient:red,blue|Gradient Fill}: This text has a horizontal gradient.
- {wavy:Wavy Text}: This text undulates.
- {rainbow:Rainbow Text}: This text cycles through rainbow colors.
- {3d:gray,4|3D Effect}: This text has a simple 3D effect.
- {neon:lime,20|Neon Sign}: This text has a strong neon glow.
- {flicker:Flicker Text}: This text flickers.
- {pulse:#FF00FF|Pulsating Beat}: This text subtly pulses.
- {shimmer:Shimmer Text}: This text has a moving light effect.
- {scanlines:Scanlines Text}: This text has subtle horizontal lines.
- {typing:Typing Text}: This text appears character by character.
- {fire:Fire Text}: This text has a simplified flame effect.
- {ice:Ice Text}: This text has an icy effect.
- {water:Water Text}: This text has a subtle water effect.
- {echo:red,5;5;5|Echo Effect}: This text has an echo effect.
- {glitch:Glitch Text}: This text randomly shifts and changes color.
- {dissolve:Dissolve Text}: This text dissolves into pixels.
- {rainbowV2:0.5|Faster Rainbow}: This text has a faster rainbow effect.
- {blurfade:Blur Fade Text}: This text blurs in and out.
- {scalepulse:0.2,250|Big Pulse}: This text pulses in scale.
- {dropshadow:#333333,8,4,4|Deep Shadow}: This text has a more detailed drop shadow.
- {waveText:8,0.1,80|Strong Wave}: This text moves in a strong wave.
- {sparkletrail:Sparkle Trail Text}: This text has trailing sparkles.
- {gradientstroke:red,purple,2|Gradient Stroke}: This text has a gradient outline.
- {vaporwave:Vaporwave Text}: This text has a retro-futuristic effect.
- {typewriter:50|Fast Type}: This text types out fast.
- {rain:Rain Text}: This text has simulated raindrops.
- {smoke:Smoke Text}: This text has a smoke-like overlay.
- {bubbling:Bubbling Text}: This text has rising bubbles.
